en.title: Thought Extinct Until 1994. Can You Name It?
en.description: This is the crested gecko of New Caledonia, thought extinct until it was rediscovered in 1994. It has no eyelids, so it cleans its eyes with its tongue, and it cannot regrow a tail once it drops it.
